text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — planning a webinar for May 21 titled "Optimizing LLM inference: practical levers for cost, latency, and reliability". Need to pick format (product-led vs deep-tech), lock speakers, and a run-of-show. Ideas: 1) 45m product + customer story + 15m Q&A, 2) 60m engineering deep dive + 15m live Q&A. Which do we prefer for demand gen?

Alex (Product): I vote product+customer for conversion. We can keep a 15min engineering appendix for folks who want the deep dive. I can lead the demo portion.

Sam (Eng): I can prepare a focused deep-dive segment showing concrete numbers: batching efficiency, KV cache hit rates, and a small live demo comparing baseline vs cached runs. Will put together a short runbook for demo failover.

Rachel (Growth): Target audience: platform engineers and infra owners at Series B/C SaaS. Channels: product newsletter, targeted LinkedIn ads, partner co-marketing with Acme. CTA: gated replay + eval credits; route inbound leads to SDR queue with tagging for Dedicated interest.

Ben (Sales): Jenna from Acme agreed to join. She can present a 7-minute segment on cost impact if we emphasize dollar savings. I'll collect before/after metrics (cost per 1k tokens, latency p50/p99) and legal approval for logos.

Jessie (Ops): Logistics: reserve webinar room (Zoom webinar), enable cloud recording and captions, provision backup laptop recording. Rehearsal schedule: 1) content dry run (slides + seg timings) 1 week prior, 2) full tech run with demo on staging 48h prior, 3) final walkthrough 24h prior.

Maya (Marketing): Draft run-of-show proposal: 
00:00-03:00 — Host welcome + agenda (Maya)
03:00-18:00 — Product demo + UX walkthrough (Alex)
18:00-28:00 — Customer case study: cost & outcomes (Jenna)
28:00-48:00 — Engineering deep-dive: batching, caching, routing + demo (Sam)
48:00-55:00 — Live Q&A (All)
55:00-60:00 — Wrap + CTA (Maya)

Alex (Product): Suggest small reorder: product -> engineering -> customer to end with a business outcome. But either order works; customer last might boost demo->close momentum.

Rachel (Growth): For copy, I'll create two landing page variants: business-first headline (dollars saved) and tech-first headline (how to cut token cost 2x). We'll A/B subject lines and register flows; add UTM params and a hidden form field for product interest (Dedicated vs Hosted).

Ben (Sales): Lead routing: gate replay with required company email, tag leads by domain, send high-intent (>=3 attendees on team) to SDRs with a playbook. I'll define MQL criteria and handoff steps.

Sam (Eng): Demo fallbacks: 1) pre-recorded video of demo, 2) synthetic dataset snapshot and trace screenshots. I will create a short failover checklist: how to switch to pre-recorded video and how to present traces if demo is down.

Jessie (Ops): Ops checklist for rehearsal: mic/camera check, share screen permissions, demo env reset steps (seed data + no live traffic), slide deck timing markers, cloud recording test, and note on meeting capacity limits. I'll set up rehearsal invites.

Maya (Marketing): Proposed speaker owners + deadlines: Alex: demo deck (10-15 slides) due in 6 days; Sam: demo script + failover assets due in 7 days; Ben: confirm Jenna + metrics and legal clearance due in 3 days; Rachel: landing page + email sequences + UTMs due in 5 days; Jessie: Zoom booking + rehearsal slots + runbook due in 4 days.

Rachel (Growth): Also recommend tracking: registration source, UTM_campaign, job role, company size, interest checkbox. We'll add survey question on what they want to learn to inform follow-ups.

Ben (Sales): I'll draft a 1-page speaker brief for Jenna with suggested talking points and a list of preferred KPIs to share. Also will confirm if Acme is comfortable with a short promo quote for social.

Alex (Product): I'll add a one-slide FAQ and a short list of recommended learning resources to include in follow-up.

Maya (Marketing): Rehearsal timeline suggestion: dry run next Wednesday (slides), full staging run Friday (demo), final 15-minute sync Monday before event. Any conflicts?

Sam (Eng): That works for Eng. Will tag the staging cluster that demo uses and provide a cron to snapshot state before rehearsal.

Jessie (Ops): I'll create a simple runbook in the webinar folder: 1) start recording, 2) host intro script, 3) transitions, 4) demo handoff, 5) start backup if needed. Also set recording retention to 90 days.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Action items locked — tagging owners above. Please update owners' cards in the marketing board and confirm rehearsal times by EOD Friday. Thanks! :rocket:
